exclusions.detailed_justification: Although marked 'split=test' in dataset/metadata.csv on Oct 18, execution of create_stratified_splits(ds_61, random_seed=42) matching the Oct 16 training run proves that TBSI_029_original.jpg was one of the 8 Tamil-Brahmi samples in the 42-sample training set when best_vit_model.pth was trained. Evaluating on this specimen evaluates training data.

exclusions.author: Neha Gautam
exclusions.detailed_justification: Comprises isolated printed, digitized, and segmented glyphs (32x32 to 128x128 px) for OCR. Lacks stone substrate, natural erosion, and multi-line inscription context. Mixing isolated characters into whole-inscription classification violates dataset/README.md Section 3 and causes domain collapse.

exclusions.author: Sakthivelan (sakthivelan01092004)
exclusions.detailed_justification: Comprises uniform 128x128 px isolated glyph icons mapped to modern Tamil letters. Lacks archaeological context, stone texture, and monumental geometry. Reserved strictly as auxiliary character reference data.

exclusions.site_group: Training & Validation Archaeological Sites (TBSI & Wikimedia Overlaps)
exclusions.exclusion_reason: SITE-LEVEL SPATIAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL DATA LEAKAGE
exclusions.detailed_justification: Because one or more photographic captures from each of these sites were included in the training or validation sets of best_vit_model.pth, all alternate angles, rubbings, and additional TBSI inscriptions from these sites must be strictly excluded from test evaluation to prevent models from learning site-specific stone color, lighting, or mineral patina.
